intent.caption: Navigation dock — A floating navigation dock of five entries with active state, machined rail, and press-down affordance.

visualSpec.effects: Floating rail 3.6w x 0.5h scene units, corner radius 0.1, brushed-metal PBR with vertical albedo ramp #1b1b23 (at 0.0) -> #101015 (at 1.0), anisotropy 0.6 along x, roughness 0.55, metalness 0.5, clearcoat 0.2, chamfered edge 0.02 catching a continuous specular line from the key light; rail floats translateZ +0.15 above a contact-shadow plane at 35 percent opacity, shadow offset 0.06 down; five entries laid out on centers 0.68 apart with 0.25-unit (1x base) horizontal padding inside each hit cell 0.6w x 0.34h; active entry Home in paper 700 with an underline bar 0.28w x 0.025h in #ff2a38 emissive intensity 1.8 seated 0.06 below its baseline; inactive entries #a6adba 400; hover inactive color #a6adba -> #e8ecf2 over 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); press per entry scale 1.0 -> 0.97 over 120ms cubic-bezier(0.175,0.885,0.32,1.275) with the cell dipping translateZ -0.03 into the rail; on active change the underline bar translates x to the new entry over 260ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1) with a weighted 1.04 overshoot; mount rise-in y +0.4 -> 0 over 700ms cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1).

sceneSpec.motionNote: Rail rises in once; the red active underline slides between entries with a weighted overshoot; pressed entries compress and dip into the rail.
sceneSpec.contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 inactive entries on rail; active underline 4.6:1 against rail
